summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute undocumented 727KB obfuscated bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses that freshly downloaded runtime to `execFileSync` a package-local file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with rotated variable names, a large numeric token array, a string-array shuffle routine, and a custom base64-like alphabet decoder — the standard opaque-payload shape. The package's declared `main` (`lib/index.js`) is a 6-line file that simply exports the string 'John', and neither README nor `package.json` documents any purpose for the Bun bundle. The obfuscated payload is reachable only through the preinstall dropper path and runs unconditionally on every `npm install`, executed by an alternate runtime that Node-based scanners do not analyze.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
